summary: Design traceable ESG data flows, quality controls, and BI integrations. Explore the five-day course and plan your reporting architecture.
lede: ESG data architecture connects sustainability disclosures to the systems, definitions, owners, and controls used in reporting. For ESG reporting leads, finance teams, sustainability managers, data engineers, BI architects, and internal auditors, the course focuses on building repeatable source-to-report data flows. Participants map disclosures to source fields, define ownership and quality checks, and design data lineage, system integrations, and assurance evidence.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals responsible for building, operating, reviewing, or governing sustainability reporting data flows.
modules: IFRS S2 and TCFD Data Models
prerequisites: Working familiarity with sustainability or non-financial reporting, finance data, BI, or data governance is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with spreadsheet software for the data-mapping and validation exercises.
